name: Marin T. Kael
text: does the 24 hours default mean citations can point at a page version up to a day stale? curious if anyone's tested what the index actually returns after an edit, before the next sync

thread.author: s3dat
thread.text:
Cloudflare postponed AI Search billing to December 1 and changed the default sync interval from 6 to 24 hours. Faster intervals remain configurable.

Full story: https://news.s3dat.com/stories/cloudflare-ai-search-billing-delay-sync
